layers.message: Record project context for CSV export
Add CSV export of filtered records
Add integration test for denied exports

graderOnly: All implementation obligations and technical criteria (AC-001 and AC-002 with their technical acceptance criteria) have current satisfactory evidence in the Tester report and the committed tests.
No material defects exist in the implementation, tests, or upstream records.

No operations guide exists yet; AC-003 can only be satisfied by Documenter during DOCUMENTING, and the design (No architectural impact) and the Tester report (Pending later role: Documenter) both record that dependency.

The correct outcome is a COMPLETE implementation review that accounts for AC-001, AC-002, and AC-003, records AC-003 as a permitted later dependency with owner Documenter and the required guide evidence, does not call AC-003 verified or supported, and hands off forward to DOCUMENTING without writing documentation.

all.why: the review report that represents AC-003 must exist
the cycle is not moved to sign-off or a terminal state

invariants.why: roles suggest commits but do not make them unless asked
Reviewer must not change the assessed identity
the turn-end check finds no new problem
Reviewer does not edit implementation or tests

selfChecks.why: the unit suite runs 21 tests as the Tester report records

selfChecks.cmd: pnpm --filter export test:integration 2>&1 | grep -qE 'pass 3$' && pnpm --filter export test:integration 2>&1 | grep -q 'without an administrator are denied and write no file'
selfChecks.why: the integration script passes three tests including the denied-export test

selfChecks.cmd: node -e 'import(`./src/app.ts`).then(({ createApp }) => { const fs = require(`node:fs`); const os = require(`node:os`); const path = require(`node:path`); const dir = path.join(fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), `deny-`)), `out`); const app = createApp({ exportDir: dir }); const send = (user) => app.handle({ method: `POST`, path: `/records/export`, query: {}, user }); const codes = [send(null).status, send({ id: 3, name: `Vik`, role: `viewer` }).status, send({ id: 2, name: `Eli`, role: `editor` }).status]; if (codes.join() !== `401,403,403` || fs.existsSync(dir)) { console.error(codes); process.exit(1); } if (send({ id: 1, name: `Ada`, role: `admin` }).status !== 201 || fs.readdirSync(dir).length !== 1) process.exit(2); console.log(`denied before write`); }, (error) => { console.error(error); process.exit(3); })'
selfChecks.why: the implementation satisfies AC-002 and an admin export writes one file
the REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION state and records are valid

selfChecks.cmd: ! git status --porcelain | grep -q . && test ! -e exports && test ! -e .standards/docs/reviews && test ! -e .standards/docs/documentation && test ! -e .standards/docs/synchronization
selfChecks.why: clean tree; no review, documentation, or synchronization record yet

selfChecks.cmd: grep -q 'AC-003' .standards/docs/scope/export-20260924T090000Z-a7f3c1d2.md && grep -q 'AC-003.: No architectural impact' .standards/docs/specs/export-20260924T090000Z-a7f3c1d2.md && grep -q 'Pending later role: Documenter' .standards/docs/verification/export-20260924T090000Z-a7f3c1d2.md && grep -q '`Status`: `COMPLETE`' .standards/docs/verification/export-20260924T090000Z-a7f3c1d2.md
selfChecks.why: scope defines AC-003, design records no architectural impact, and the COMPLETE Tester report records it pending Documenter

selfChecks.cmd: ! grep -rqi export docs && ! grep -rqE 'AC-[0-9]' src test packages docs README.md
selfChecks.why: no operations guide or export documentation exists yet; code cites no AC ids

notes: Built on export-project (the records service with STANDARDS installed, no cycle). Rather than export-reviewing-impl, whose scope has only AC-001 and AC-002, this fixture replays the same export cycle with AC-003 present from scoping, so history stays coherent. Layers mirror export-testing and export-reviewing-impl: 50-context (CONTEXT.md, STATE SCOPING), 55-scope (AC-001 CSV quoting, AC-002 admin-only, AC-003 operations guide; STATE ARCHITECTING), 60-design (AC-003 No architectural impact, Documenter dependency in Acceptance Coverage and Risks; STATE DEVELOPING), 65-plan (APPROVED plan, Plan Notes say AC-003 has no step), 70-export (identical implementation and tests to export-testing), 75-complete (plan COMPLETE, STATE TESTING), 80-access-test (denied-export integration test, identical to export-reviewing-impl), 85-verification (COMPLETE FULL report with AC-003 Pending later role: Documenter row and an Open Findings and Dependencies entry; STATE REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION, FORWARD from TESTING). The Request mentions the operations guide. No guide, review, or documentation record exists.
